task_title: Emulator desync/frame-staleness signals and data-growth gauges
task_criteria: PROOF: bash scripts/mon5_checks.sh a exits 0 printing "21 passed" and "MON5-A OK". FAILIF: any test failure/error, collection error, or a different count.

PROOF: bash scripts/mon5_checks.sh b exits 0 printing "age_before 0.0 fires_before False age_after 7200 fires_after True" and "MON5-B OK". FAILIF: the gauge reads the wall clock instead of the ledger mtime, the age does not jump to 7200, or the PromQL age>3600 query does not go from empty to firing.

PROOF: bash scripts/mon5_checks.sh c exits 0 printing "requests health/ok: [50.0] active after burst+shutdown: [0.0]" and "MON5-C OK". FAILIF: the health/ok counter is not exactly 50 after the 5x10 burst, or any active-connection worker leaks (gauge not back to 0 after burst and shutdown).

PROOF: bash scripts/mon5_checks.sh d exits 0 printing "desync before / after cycle1 / after cycle2: 0.0 0.0 1.0" and "MON5-D OK". FAILIF: the counter increments on the first frozen cycle, fails to increment on the second, or the integrity tracker is not wired after _cycle_observe.

PROOF: bash scripts/mon5_checks.sh e exits 0 printing "families: 7" and "MON5-E OK" (all seven aipp_* families named in docs/observability-spec.md sections 3.2 rows 17-23, 3.3 + 3.3.1, and 8.6 item 6). FAILIF: any of the seven family names is missing from those sections or a feed-site line was dropped from the SHIPPED rows.

items.detail: Ran `bash scripts/mon5_checks.sh a` fresh: exit_code=0, output "collected 21 items ... 21 passed in 3.37s" and "MON5-A OK". All 21 tests in tests/test_mon_aipp5.py (TestDeclarations, TestDesyncProxy, TestRunlogStalenessQuery, TestBridgeBurst) collected and passed with zero errors; re-ran in the batch loop — stable at exit=0.

items.criterion: PROOF: bash scripts/mon5_checks.sh b exits 0 printing "age_before 0.0 fires_before False age_after 7200 fires_after True" and "MON5-B OK". FAILIF: the gauge reads the wall clock instead of the ledger mtime, the age does not jump to 7200, or the PromQL age>3600 query does not go from empty to firing.
items.detail: Ran `bash scripts/mon5_checks.sh b`: exit_code=0, output exactly "age_before 0.0 fires_before False age_after 7200 fires_after True" + "MON5-B OK". The check drives the real cron_runner._publish_data_growth_metrics against a temp ledger, ages the file with os.utime to 7200s old, re-publishes, and asserts a0<3600, a1>3600, |a1-7200|<120 — proving the gauge is fed from stat.st_mtime (cron_runner.py:9304-9307 sets last_write from st_mtime; metrics.py:154 help "Unix timestamp of the last write"), not a synthetic now, and the age>3600 query goes empty→firing.

items.criterion: PROOF: bash scripts/mon5_checks.sh c exits 0 printing "requests health/ok: [50.0] active after burst+shutdown: [0.0]" and "MON5-C OK". FAILIF: the health/ok counter is not exactly 50 after the 5x10 burst, or any active-connection worker leaks (gauge not back to 0 after burst and shutdown).
items.detail: Ran `bash scripts/mon5_checks.sh c`: exit_code=0, output exactly "requests health/ok: [50.0] active after burst+shutdown: [0.0]" + "MON5-C OK". The check opens 50 real TCP connections (5 waves × 10, ThreadPoolExecutor) against a live game_bridge.serve thread (max_workers=4, stop_event), reads aipp_bridge_requests_total{cmd=health,outcome=ok}==50.0 and aipp_bridge_active_connections==0.0 after stop.set()+join — no worker leak. Feed sites verified in source: scripts/game_bridge.py:488 (observe_bridge_request in handle() finally — every exit counted once) and :578/:594/:609/:696 (set_bridge_active_connections at bind, admit, discard, shutdown).

items.criterion: PROOF: bash scripts/mon5_checks.sh d exits 0 printing "desync before / after cycle1 / after cycle2: 0.0 0.0 1.0" and "MON5-D OK". FAILIF: the counter increments on the first frozen cycle, fails to increment on the second, or the integrity tracker is not wired after _cycle_observe.
items.detail: Ran `bash scripts/mon5_checks.sh d`: exit_code=0, output "desync before / after cycle1 / after cycle2: 0.0 0.0 1.0" + "MON5-D OK". The check runs the REAL cron_runner._cycle_header against a frozen-frame/frozen-tile emulator stub: counter stays 0.0 through cycle 1 (no previous observation) and reaches 1.0 after the second identical cycle. Wiring verified in source: _cycle_header calls _cycle_observe at cron_runner.py:9546 then _track_emulator_integrity at :9558 (tracker after both frame hash and RAM observation exist), and the proxy logic at :9255-9280 requires repeated_frame AND ram_tile_unchanged with tile_known.

items.criterion: PROOF: bash scripts/mon5_checks.sh e exits 0 printing "families: 7" and "MON5-E OK" (all seven aipp_* families named in docs/observability-spec.md sections 3.2 rows 17-23, 3.3 + 3.3.1, and 8.6 item 6). FAILIF: any of the seven family names is missing from those sections or a feed-site line was dropped from the SHIPPED rows.
items.detail: Ran `bash scripts/mon5_checks.sh e`: exit_code=0, output "families: 7" + "MON5-E OK". Verified the ranges map to the named sections: lines 341-347 are §3.2 P3 rows 17-23 and alone contain all seven family names; lines 381-430 are the §3.3 UPDATE block + §3.3.1 desync-proxy semantics (aipp_emulator_desync_total, §8.6 item-6 reference at :426); lines 990-1000 reach §8. Known risks (item 6 status at :1021-1031, adjacent). SHIPPED feed-site rows intact: lines 71-78 list all seven rows 17-23 with definition + production feed site each (e.g. row 22 → game_bridge.py:488, row 23 → serve() :593/:607/:578/:696), none dropped.

items.criterion: Derived: the mon5 checks exercise REAL production code paths (cron_runner._cycle_header/_run_cycles/_finalize_run, game_bridge handle()/serve()), not parallel scaffolding — the seven families are fed from the shipped wiring
items.detail: Source evidence: cron_runner.py:9558 (_track_emulator_integrity inside _cycle_header after _cycle_observe at :9546), cron_runner.py:9139 (_publish_data_growth_metrics() per cycle in _run_cycles), cron_runner.py:11525 (published after log_file.close() at :11523 in _finalize_run), scripts/game_bridge.py:488/578/594/609/696, src/observability/metrics.py:132-167 (all seven declared once with correct Counter/Gauge types — also asserted by tests/test_mon_aipp5.py TestDeclarations). The module-level seam holds: main() declares `global log_path` (cron_runner.py:8472) so the no-arg per-cycle call reads the real ledger path.

items.criterion: Derived: all five checks are deterministic and re-run stable (exit 0 twice in the same session, exact output both times)
items.detail: Command `for x in a b c d e; do bash scripts/mon5_checks.sh $x; done` (fresh second run): "check a exit=0 :: MON5-A OK / check b exit=0 :: MON5-B OK / check c exit=0 :: MON5-C OK / check d exit=0 :: MON5-D OK / check e exit=0 :: MON5-E OK". The d check also prints frame_stale_seconds ≈0.0005 (fresh monotonic measurement), consistent across runs.
